question: By whose agency does a speaker come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
It is by that lord's grace that knowledge arises.
Through that grace the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
inference: Recognition of the Kaula determination is attributed solely to the grace of the lord of the Kaulas.
uncertainties: The prior state of ignorance is implied but not elaborated.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
